IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCTPROD_DEP') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCTPROD_DEP;
END;

WITH
AccountProductSK AS (
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimAccountProduct
)
, FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION 
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication A
	JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication GROUP BY FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
	ON A.FinancialProductId = B.FinancialProductId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
)

SELECT 
DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBCH.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm    
INTO DW.ACCTPROD_DEP             
FROM (SELECT CustomerAccountId,ProductID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') BCAFP
JOIN FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionID = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBCH ON BCA.BranchId = DDBCH.BranchID
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND BCAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')


IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_DEP') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_DEP;
END;

WITH
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,ProductSK
    ,ProductID
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK                  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.ACCTPROD_DEP
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,ProductSK
    ,ProductID
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK                  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,ProductID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
)


    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
    ,ISNULL(SRC.ProductID,TGT.ProductID) AS ProductID
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL AND TGT.ProductID IS NULL  THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'    
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
INTO DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_DEP	
FROM TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.AccountID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.ProductID IS NULL)



--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimAccountProduct TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_DEP DELTA ON DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.ProductID = TGT.ProductID AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.ACCTPROD_DEP SRC ON SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK  AND SRC.ProductID = TGT.ProductID  AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' ;


SELECT CustomerAccountId,ProductID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId ,* FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
SELECT CustomerAccountId,ProductID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND (PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR  PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01')

INSERT INTO DW.DimAccountProduct (
AccountProductSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,ProductSK
,ProductID
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm      )              
SELECT
AccountProductSK
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,ProductSK
,SRC.ProductID
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm  
FROM DW.ACCTPROD_DEP SRC
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimAccountProduct_DELTA_DEP DELTA ON DELTA.ProductID = SRC.ProductID AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')
--Where sourcesystemcode is not null
